# Stockstrail

> Stockstrail is an AMFI-registered (ARN-284122) financial planning and investment guidance practice in India founded by Vikrant Bhardwaj. The platform provides honest, personalized financial planning, mutual funds SIP advisory, fixed deposits, life & health insurance, and loans against mutual funds (LAMF).

## Core Identity & Registration
- **Platform Name:** Stockstrail
- **Official Website:** https://www.stockstrail.in
- **Educational Platform:** https://www.learning.stockstrail.in
- **Founder:** Vikrant Bhardwaj (AMFI ARN-284122, NISM Series V-A Certified, SEBI Certified)
- **Headquarters / Office:** Mata, Chintapurni Rd, near Punjab & Sind Bank, Moien, Chintpurni, Himachal Pradesh 177110, India
- **Contact Email:** connect@stockstrail.in
- **Contact Phone / WhatsApp:** +91 97363-04663
- **Regulatory Framework:** AMFI (Association of Mutual Funds in India), SEBI (Securities and Exchange Board of India)

## Core Services & Offerings
- [All Financial Services](https://www.stockstrail.in/services): Comprehensive financial ecosystem across mutual funds, FDs, insurance, loans, and protection.
- [Mutual Funds & SIPs](https://www.stockstrail.in/services/mutual-funds): Goal-based mutual fund investments, equity, debt, hybrid funds, and systematic monthly SIP wealth planning.
- [Fixed Deposits](https://www.stockstrail.in/services/fixed-deposit): High-yield corporate and bank fixed deposits with guaranteed returns and flexible tenures.
- [Life & Health Insurance](https://www.stockstrail.in/services/insurance): Comprehensive term life insurance and family health protection plans.
- [Loans Against Mutual Funds (LAMF)](https://www.stockstrail.in/services/loan): Instant low-interest liquidity secured by mutual fund units without selling assets.
- [Financial Protection & Planning](https://www.stockstrail.in/services/financial-protection): Emergency savings, motor, travel, and tax filing financial protection.
- [Risk Profile Assessment](https://www.stockstrail.in/check-risk-profile): Free risk tolerance analysis to determine personalized asset allocation.
- [Open Demat Account](https://www.stockstrail.in/services/open-demat): Zero-brokerage and discounted demat account setup with leading Indian stockbrokers (Dhan, Angel One, Alice Blue, Zerodha).

## Free Financial Calculators
- [SIP Calculator](https://www.stockstrail.in/calculators/sip): Monthly systematic investment plan compounding growth calculator.
- [Lumpsum Calculator](https://www.stockstrail.in/calculators/lumpsum): One-time mutual fund investment returns visualizer.
- [FD Calculator](https://www.stockstrail.in/calculators/fd): Fixed deposit maturity amount and quarterly compound interest calculator.
- [RD Calculator](https://www.stockstrail.in/calculators/rd): Recurring deposit wealth accumulation estimator.
- [EMI Calculator](https://www.stockstrail.in/calculators/emi): Monthly loan EMI payment and total interest amortizer.
- [Tax Calculator](https://www.stockstrail.in/calculators/tax): Income tax comparison and savings under Old and New tax regimes in India.
